quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April-September 2025): net sales JPY 326,204 million (+9.3% year on year), operating income JPY 48,700 million (+22.7%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 23,870 million (-7.7%) after business restructuring costs for ending NAS battery manufacturing and sales were booked as an extraordinary loss. Digital Society Business: net sales JPY 97,827 million (+23.6%), operating income JPY 13,506 million (+157.2%). Management states that for semiconductor manufacturing equipment products, plans for new leading-edge foundry fabs have been pushed back, but shipments increased on inventory build-up at some customers. Environment Business net sales JPY 197,398 million (+2.5%); Energy & Industry Business net sales JPY 32,120 million (+17.9%) with an operating loss of JPY 1,773 million.
